svg.title: Orange Green
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and vivid palette. Orange bulb curves from left middle to right side and lower-left; green rectangular painted support retained.
svg.metadata: Reference:https://archive.org/download/EllsworthKelly20132/EllsworthKelly20132.pdf#page=19; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable interpretation, not a facsimile.
